objective: Run the cheapest identity/support falsifier for every root-census PARK_B node without opening held graph outcomes.

decision_rules.B_to_A: Only banked positive class support at or above the binding +0.005 adjusted threshold with nonnegative raw/node and a complete identity prerequisite may be proposed.
decision_rules.B_to_C: Only banked zero/weak class support or a complete named identity/support falsification may be proposed; absence alone remains PARK_B unless the node contract explicitly defines it as a negative.
decision_rules.unchanged: Missing prerequisites, sibling-wave dependencies, and quarantined memo claims remain PARK_B.

predeclared_support_interpretations.GAP-F1: P0 one-gap score deltas below +0.005 on both families are weak banked class support and propose PARK_C for this exact class instantiation.
predeclared_support_interpretations.DET-F0: P0 free node-add has exactly zero score, adjusted/raw edge, and node-recall deltas; propose PARK_C for this exact free-node instantiation.
predeclared_support_interpretations.G2: N1 is frozen GO and P0 swap/delete class support exceeds +0.005 on both families; propose PARK_A for the feasibility-exact decision-focused mechanism while preserving graph gating.
predeclared_support_interpretations.all_other_nodes: Run evidence identity and prerequisite/support presence checks; do not infer a move from absence or a sibling's live work.
